metric_notes.top_5_score: mean of normalized best runtimes over prefixes 1..min(5,n)
metric_notes.endpoint_top_5_score: original-pool reference / fastest runtime in the first five picks
metric_notes.paper_network_scores: ratio of sums of task-frequency-weighted private normalizers and recovered selected latencies; separate from macro scores
metric_notes.pilot_network_scores: partial-inventory ratios are named pilot_network; they are not complete paper-network results
metric_notes.filtered_pairwise_metrics: omitted; unshown tails are not model rankings
metric_notes.repeat_std: sample standard deviation of run aggregates, not a confidence interval
metric_notes.paired_tests: exploratory unadjusted sign tests of repeat-averaged within-workload differences
metric_notes.cost: recorded token counts only; cached tokens are historical, not newly charged

publication_note: Output directory sanitized for publication; original source hash is in provenance.json.
